CustomField.description: Results: the average Score across this template's five point questions (the worded scales and the 1 to 5 rating), so it reads from 1 to 5. Each question's own average is on its Form Template Result. Written by the Recalculate Results job.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The average score across this form's 1 to 5 questions. A question on another scale, such as 0 to 10, keeps its own average under Question results.
CustomField.label: Average Score
